content: 1. The document titled eTherapy for People Living with HIV in Resource-Constrained Settings was accessed on December 29, 2016. 2. A meeting report titled Assessment of World Health Organization HIV Drug Resistance Early Warning Indicators details the outcomes of the Early Advisory Indicator Panel meeting held on August 11–12, 2011, in Geneva, Switzerland. This report was accessed on September 7, 2016. 3. The Consolidated Strategic Information Guidelines for HIV in the Health Sector document provides comprehensive guidance and was accessed on May 2, 2017. 4. The 2015 revision of A Guide to Monitoring and Evaluation for Collaborative TB/HIV Activities was accessed on September 7, 2016. 5. A fact sheet on tuberculosis diagnostics, specifically the Xpert MTB/RIF test, was accessed on September 7, 2016.
